description.value: Ginger Indian Cuisine is an authentic Indian restaurant in Richmond serving a wide-ranging menu that draws from multiple regional traditions, including tandoori specialties, slow-cooked biryanis, and rich curries. The restaurant is Halal certified by HIC Canada and has been recognized by Restaurantji as one of Richmond's best. Cyclists will find a full dine-in experience alongside takeout and delivery, with vegetarian and celiac-friendly items clearly identified on the menu.

bike_parking_detail: 6 racks within 100m: rack at 35m; rack at 35m; rack at 43m; rack (covered) at 56m; rack (covered) at 84m; rack at 85m.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content is fully available and confirms the business is a real, operating restaurant offering dine-in, takeout, and delivery. OSM check_date of 2026-05-20 is recent and supports open status. Phone (+1 604-370-1300) and address (9100 Blundell Rd #490, Richmond, BC) match between OSM and website. Vegetarian dishes (paneer items, Channa Bhatura) and celiac-friendly labeling are confirmed by website menu copy; no bike-specific amenities are mentioned anywhere on the site or in OSM tags.
concerns: The rewards signup page references the domain 'gingerindiancuisine.ca' (a .ca TLD) while the primary OSM and website URL uses 'gingerindiancuisine.com' (.com TLD). Minor discrepancy; likely a secondary domain, but worth monitoring.

Website address uses postal code V6Y 3X9 and unit #490, which are not included in the OSM top-level address field (though addr:unit=490 is present as a separate OSM tag). Updated address field to use the more complete website version.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active, publicly accessible restaurant with recent OSM check_date and a live website. Offers takeout suitable for cyclists and a diverse menu including vegetarian and gluten-free options.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Menu includes multiple vegetarian dishes (Paneer Pakora, Paneer Handi, Channa Bhatura, vegetable Biryani). Website also has a dedicated celiac/gluten-free section describing clear menu labeling and cross-contamination prevention protocols

price.label: Casual
price.signal: Mains $15-17: Channa Bhatura, Paneer Handi, Biryani
